TeamMember.title: TeamMember
TeamMember.description: Represents a student team member in an organization, with role, department, year of study, and contact details.

id.description: Unique identifier for the team member

name.description: Full name of the team member

rollNo.description: College Roll number or registration ID

department.description: Academic course or programme of study

year.description: Academic year of study (e.g., 1st Year, 2nd Year, etc.)

AttendanceSession.title: AttendanceSession
AttendanceSession.description: Represents a dated attendance tracking session for a team or all teams with individual member attendance status.

id.description: Unique identifier for the attendance session

date.description: Date of the attendance session in YYYY-MM-DD format

sessionSlot.description: Session slot after selecting date: FN (Forenoon) or AN (Afternoon)

title.description: Meeting name or purpose of the attendance check

team.description: Target team or ALL for multi-team attendance

records.description: Record mapping member IDs to status (PRESENT, ABSENT, INFORMED) and notes

notes.description: General notes or agenda for this session

createdBy.description: Account username who registered or last saved the attendance

/members/{memberId}.description: Collection of all student team members persisted securely in Firestore

/attendance/{sessionId}.description: Collection of attendance sessions and member check-in records
